summary.en: Immunology and rare-disease registrational programs broaden Biogen’s neurology pipeline. Licensed and acquired assets contribute prominently to its late-stage portfolio.
summary.zh: 免疫和罕见病注册性项目拓宽了 Biogen 的神经科学管线。授权引进和收购的资产在其后期组合中占据突出位置。

ind.en: Systemic lupus erythematosus; also cutaneous lupus
ind.zh: 系统性红斑狼疮;另有皮肤型狼疮

next.en: TOPAZ-1/2 results in first half of December 2026; CLE results H1 2027
next.zh: TOPAZ-1/2 结果将在 2026 年 12 月上半月公布;CLE 结果在 H1 2027

ind.zh: 抗体介导的肾移植排斥反应;另有 IgAN/PMN

watch.en: TOPAZ-1/2 lupus results are expected in early December; AMR and CLE results in H1 2027.
watch.zh: TOPAZ-1/2 狼疮结果预计在 12 月初公布;AMR 和 CLE 结果在 H1 2027。

watch.en: MS product revenue fell 13% year on year in Q3.
watch.zh: 第三季度 MS 产品收入同比下降 13%。

watch.en: September cash was $1.3bn against approximately $7.7bn debt.
The Q3 filing documents Ionis, UCB, Stoke and HI-Bio-linked economics across selected programs.
watch.zh: 第三季度申报文件记录了部分项目中与 Ionis、UCB、Stoke 和 HI-Bio 相关的经济条款。
